definitions.short: a dripping i.e. of honey (from the comb)
definitions.full: H5317. nopheth נֹ֫פֶת noun masculine Prov 24:13 flowing honey, honey from the comb (Phoenician נפת CIS i.166, 8b ); — ׳נ absolute 5:3 3 t., construct Psa 19:11 ; — sweet Prov 24:13 (|| דְּבַשׁ ), compare 27:7 ; figurative of sweet words 5:3 , and perhaps Song 4:11 (Bu of kisses; || חָלָב דְּבַשׁ, ); in full צוּפִים ׳נ Psa 19:11 honey of (the) combs (compare with י ׳מִשְׁפְטֵי ; || דְּבַשׁ ). נֶפְתּוֺחַ see פתח . נַפְתָּלִי נַמְּתּוּלִים, see פתל .
definitions.rootNote: from 5130 in the sense of shaking to pieces;
